items.title: Observing prethermal dynamical phase transitions on QuEra Aquila with Amazon Braket
items.summary: This post was contributed by Katherine Klymko, Alexey Khudorozhkov, Pedro L. S. Lopes, Milan Kornjača, Tommaso Macrì, Trevor Chaloux, and Peter Komar. What happens when interacting quantum particles are suddenly pushed far from equilibrium? Can their motion settle into long-lived patterns, and can those patterns undergo abrupt transitions of their own? In a new Nature […]
